review_comments: @paulidale @hlandau @levitte ISO C does not allow to convert functional pointer to `(void*)`, so `TEST_ptr(.)` and `TEST_ptr_null(.)` macros do not work. My idea was to introduce macros `TEST_func_ptr(.)`, `TEST_func_ptr_null(.)`.
